title: Code and Data Package: Direct Optimization of Stellarator Omnigenity from the Second Adiabatic Invariant
description: Standalone Python/JAX DESC implementation of the differentiable action-residual objective (f_J), soft-connectivity regularizer (f_SC), and SplineZetaMin parameterization, together with final equilibria, modular coils, verification datasets (SIMPLE, NEO, COBRA, SFINCS, vacuum Poincare, and VMEC2000 free-boundary outputs), and figure-reproduction scripts supporting Nuclear Fusion manuscript NF-109458.
